xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate
interaction.
Index DB lock does not encompass Content RPC.
False-acceptance rollback/discard failures enter the same catch as completion exceptions.
Warnings are conditional on finalize failure.
